name: Limit sprite speed
description: Keeps the touching sprite from going faster than a maximum: its X speed (!B6, both ways) or its speed downwards (!AA), in the sprite tables ($B6 and $AA without SA-1). A sprite that is slower is left alone. As the Sprite/Shell Speed Limiter blocks of the archive (SMWC 32053 and 35601).
author: BlockCreator
